license.title: License
license.description: Enter the signed EAI license key. Validation is performed locally and does not require an internet connection. Leave the field empty to start the GPM demo with sample electricity prices.

data_description.license_key: The license key starts with EAI1. and is issued by your EAI provider. Leave it empty for the GPM demo with sample prices.

tariff.title: Tariff model
tariff.description: Select the tariff model and electricity market. Additional models require a license with tariff-model entitlement.

data_description.tariff_mode: Dynamic uses aWATTar day-ahead prices. Other models need tariff-model entitlement.
data_description.country: Select your electricity market (Germany or Austria)

pricing.title: Price Configuration
pricing.description:
Current spot price (gross): **{spot_price} ct/kWh**

You can either calibrate automatically by entering your current total price, or manually enter the individual components.

data.calibration_price: Your current total price (from provider app)

data_description.vat_rate: VAT rate applied to spot price (19% DE, 20% AT, 7% reduced)
data_description.use_calibration: Calculate markup automatically from your current price
data_description.calibration_price: Enter the price shown in your provider's app right now
data_description.grid_fee: Network charges from your grid operator (gross, incl. VAT)
data_description.taxes_fees: Electricity tax, EEG surcharge, etc. (gross, incl. VAT)
data_description.battery_power_sensor: Power sensor for battery charging from grid (optional)

tariff_fixed.title: Fixed tariff
tariff_fixed.description: Enter the constant gross price in ct/kWh.

data_description.fixed_total_price: Gross customer price for every hour

tariff_time_of_use.title: Time-of-use tariff
tariff_time_of_use.description: High tariff applies between the start and end times. If the end is earlier than the start, the window wraps midnight.

data_description.tou_high_price: Gross price during the high-tariff window
data_description.tou_low_price: Gross price outside the high-tariff window
data_description.tou_high_start: Local time when the high tariff begins
data_description.tou_high_end: Local time when the high tariff ends
data_description.tou_weekend_low: Saturday and Sunday always use the low tariff
data_description.tou_holiday_low: Nationwide public holidays use the low tariff

tariff_time_windows.title: Time windows

window_add.title: Edit time window
window_add.description: Name the window and choose days and times. Overlapping windows on the same weekday are rejected.

data_description.window_end: Local end time; earlier than start wraps midnight
data_description.window_price: Gross price while this window is active
data_description.window_weekdays: At least one weekday is required

windows_done.title: Default window price
windows_done.description: Hours that match no window use this default gross price.

data_description.default_price: Used when no named window matches

tariff_csv_community.title: Community CSV tariff
tariff_csv_community.description: Choose the live base tariff. CSV files are imported later from Options.

data_description.csv_base_mode: Used for live hours until a CSV import is applied
data_description.csv_timezone: How offset-less CSV timestamps are read

common.title: Threshold, battery and fees
common.description: These settings apply to every tariff model. Feed-in and the monthly base fee default to 8.1 ct/kWh and 0 EUR for new setups.

csv_map.description: Confirm the detected profile, unit and timezone, then map the CSV columns.

data_description.profile: Price list (P1) or community share (P2). Auto uses the header.
data_description.price_unit: Shown in the preview; auto uses a median heuristic
data_description.timezone: Used only when timestamps have no offset

csv_preview.title: CSV preview
csv_preview.description: Range {range_from} – {range_to}, {row_count} rows, unit {detected_unit}. Hours with history: {hours_matched}, new hours: {hours_new}. Monthly corrections that become stale: {stale_months}. Apply writes past hours only.

data_description.confirm: Overwrites matching history hours and stores raw prices for undo

monthly_correction.title: Monthly correction
monthly_correction.description: Adjust a completed month so hourly GPM prices match the billed energy and amount. Only the last 24 completed months are available.

data_description.month: Completed months only; the current month cannot be selected
data_description.billed_kwh: Energy from the supplier bill in kWh
data_description.billed_eur: Amount from the supplier bill in EUR
data_description.base_fee_eur: Optional standing charge subtracted before the target price
data_description.method: Additive shift is the default; multiplicative scales every hour
data_description.weighting: Consumption uses STATS hourly grid import; otherwise equal hours
data_description.force: Required when fewer than half of the month hours exist in GPM history

monthly_correction_preview.title: Monthly correction preview
monthly_correction_preview.description: Month {month}: mean {mean_price} ct/kWh, target {target_price} ct/kWh, delta {delta}, factor {factor}. Coverage {coverage_percent}%, energy deviation {energy_deviation_percent}%, hours {hours}. Fallback {fallback_reason}. Energy warning {energy_warning}.

data_description.confirm: Writes past hours only, stores raw prices for undo, and raises the price revision

corrections_manage.title: Manage corrections
corrections_manage.description: Revert an applied CSV or monthly correction. Raw prices and the original source are restored.

data_description.correction_id: Only applied corrections can be reverted
data_description.confirm_revert: Restores total_price from total_price_raw and clears the correction id
